limitations: Mocked protocol execution does not establish rendering, codecs/devices, platform capture behavior, live streaming, or real OBS performance.
A finite watchdog expiration records that no bounded response was observed; it does not prove an indefinite hang.
The disconnect probe closes before applying an idempotent scene setter; it cannot establish behavior after an applied non-idempotent mutation.

result.instructions: OBS Studio control server speaking the OBS WebSocket v5 protocol. Typical flow: obs-get-status to check the connection, obs-get-scene-list / obs-get-input-list to inspect the current scene graph, obs-set-current-scene / obs-create-scene to manage scenes, obs-start-stream / obs-stop-stream / obs-start-record / obs-stop-record for output control, obs-set-input-mute / obs-set-input-volume for audio, and obs-trigger-transition for studio mode. If a request fails because OBS is not running, start OBS with the WebSocket server enabled (Tools > WebSocket Server Settings) and retry; the connection re-establishes automatically.
